title: GTSIO-520-H (R10 mechanism study): closure checks and global constraints
note: Every published figure was read from the page image of the user's own copy of X-30045A (not only the OCR text) on 19 Oct 2026; the page and item are in each locator. A figure that could not be read from a source is a check marked `unknown` with the reason. The IO-520 manual is a related engine and is not used as evidence.

manual.path: Notes/gtsio520_series.pdf in the course folder (outside Git)
manual.pages: PDF page = page of the file; the printed page id (for example C-3-2) is given beside it

checks.title: Six cylinders of 5.250 in bore and 4.000 in stroke sweep the stated 520 cubic inches

source.where: C-3-2 (PDF p.152): Detail Engine Specifications, Bore, Stroke, Displacement
A-1-1 (PDF p.13) section 1-2 and A-2-1/A-2-2 (PDF p.15): six cylinders, four piston strokes per cycle

tolerance.why: the manual prints 520 to the nearest cubic inch, so half a unit is the rounding it can hide

checks.title: 2275 propeller rpm through the 0.667:1 reduction is an engine speed inside the stated rated-speed band

source.where: C-3-2 (PDF p.152): 375 horsepower at 2275 propeller rpm; Propeller Drive Ratio 0.667:1
C-3-4 (PDF p.154) item (b): Maximum Rated RPM and Tolerance 3375 - 3425; item (x) Normal Rated Power 375 BHP at 3400 RPM

checks.title: PLANK power from the rated 375 hp at 3400 rpm: the mean effective pressure it implies

source.where: C-3-4 (PDF p.154) item (x): Normal Rated Power 375 BHP at 3400 RPM; bore and stroke as in displacement-from-bore-stroke

checks.note: X-30045A states no mean or brake mean effective pressure (searched the Detail Engine Specifications and Operating Test Limits pages, C-3-2 to C-3-4), so P cannot be taken from a source and the forward check, P x L x A x N x K = stated power, is not run. The implied pressure is reported only; an expected band needs a source (an engine data sheet or a dynamometer record) before it becomes a check.

checks.title: The modelled parts weigh no more than the published standard engine dry weight (upper bound only)

source.where: C-3-3 (PDF p.153): Standard Engine Dry Weight (Lbs.) 550.39

checks.density_source: nominal handbook values, not from X-30045A. Gasket, babbitt and insulator have no density here on purpose: the run is `unknown` until each is priced from a source.
checks.note: The published weight is the complete engine with its purchased accessories (turbocharger, intercooler, oil cooler, controller, fuel pump and regulator, alternator, starter, magnetos; A-2-1 PDF p.15), so only an upper bound is meaningful for a model that leaves most of them out. There is no lower bound without a weight breakdown. R10's per-part volumes are in the build output (geometry.json, 91 MB, ignored by Git) and are not committed, so the check is `unknown` unless that file is on the machine or passed with --volumes.

source.verified: text search of the OCR for weight, ounce, gram, lb; the three pages above read as images

checks.title: The pad-rotation labels (clockwise, counterclockwise) cannot fix the crank direction until the viewpoint they are read from is known

source.where: C-3-2 and C-3-3 (PDF p.152-153): the accessory-drive rotations are each 'facing engine drive pad'; the same footnote is on the propeller line
EASA TCDS IM.E.248 issue 01, 8 Nov 2022, p.8: drive directions 'viewing drive pad' (cited by number; the PDF is not committed)
source.verified: read by the closure-check session on 20 Oct 2026

checks.unknown: The labels come in two self-consistent sets that differ only in an undefined viewpoint (observer outside the engine looking at the pad, or at the engine looking out): the magnetos, governor and optional accessory give a clockwise crank under the first reading and a counterclockwise one under the second, the propeller line ('looking forward', one external mesh) gives counterclockwise under both. Only the second reading makes every source line agree, and it is the one the model now follows, but the labels alone do not choose it. The operator's handbook for the -H, X-30129 (not held), or a first-hand look at a real engine settles it: turn the propeller by hand in its running direction and the magneto drive coupling, seen from behind, should turn counterclockwise.

source.where: C-3-2 (PDF p.152): Compression Ratio 7.5:1

checks.unknown: The combustion-chamber volume of the modelled head is not in the committed data (it needs the head solid from the build output), and the manual gives no chamber volume. Swept volume per cylinder is 86.6 cubic inches, so 7.5:1 would need a clearance volume of 13.3 cubic inches; the model's value is not available to compare.
